blocks.text: Tojoyify Professional FAR AIM Tabs for ASA 2026Brand StoryTojoyify is specialized in designing and producing various kinds of Index Tabs. We have designed Bible Tabs, DSM-5 Tabs, FAR/AIM Tabs and so on. We adopt high-quality printing material and environmentally-friendly printing oil, so customers rate highly of our products.

items.label: Highlight Common Areas of Focus in FAR/AIM 2026 Book
items.value: The designer has taken part in the Private Pilot Exam himself. For developing this product, he has done a lot of research and collected bound of information to identify the most important parts in this huge book.

items.label: Color-Coded, Easy to Navigate
items.value: The tabs are designed in different colors. Tabs of the same part are of the same or similar color, so it’s very easy for you to find different sections.

items.label: Durable and Waterproof
items.value: These tabs are laminated for protection, so they’re tear-resistant and very durable, also waterproof, perfect for your study. PVC material, smooth in surface, and fluent to write on.

items.label: Easy to Apply and Remove
items.value: Just peel and stick, they are easy to install! Each tab is self-adhesive and pre-scored in the middle for easy folding. If you make a mistake, you can pull it off easily without tearing your books and reapply.

items.label: Clear Application Guide
items.value: Tab Alignment Guide and Instructions included. You can line them up nicely with the tab guide.
